facts.business: Prime Securities Limited is a financial services company providing corporate advisory, investment banking, wealth management, and asset management services through its subsidiaries in India, UK, and UAE.

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of matter on recognition of Minimum Alternate Tax (MAT) credit for the first time based on future utilization projections (Note 17.1).

key_risks: Revenue recognition involves significant management judgement in identifying performance obligations and allocation of consideration
New businesses (wealth management, asset management, overseas subsidiaries) are in initial stages with expenses debited to P&L
Dependence on lumpy advisory revenues vs steady fee-based income
Forward-looking statements subject to risks and uncertainties beyond company's control
